problem: Required preflight treats unrelated main commits as out-of-scope changes when the PR branch diverges from today's event base.
root_cause: For PR event base=903bf0ceecc339cd59df6c68e20245861f7f25fa and owner head=fae5812fee571e26da284c4f1e5c27305b8699e9, git diff --name-only base head reported 126 delivery files. GitHub compare provides authoritative merge_base=f627153ed569820917a2dc5787dd210613f0395e and six actual owner-only files.

evidence.main_drift: main advanced independently while the unchanged SQL PR head remained valid as a PR diff

remediation: Resolve the GitHub compare API's provider-verified merge_base_commit SHA for exact base and head identities before PR file-scope classification. Preserve event base for merge-group and independent production checks. Fail closed on provider errors, mismatched head/base, malformed SHA, unexpected branch changes and uncertain ancestry.
prevention: Never count unrelated protected-main changes in a candidate's Change-Scope.
Reject unauthorized new candidate-owned files even when comparing from the correct merge base.
Verify provider response for both exact base and head commit; never infer from mutable branch names.
Keep normal Required, CodeQL, Supabase Preview, protected merge and production cron readback requirements.
Do not mutate another writer-leased PR, introduce parallel schedulers or declare the P0 revenue snapshot fixed from CI hygiene alone.
